extraction_scope: Worker-6 source-reviewed mechanism ontology bounded to local XML/PDF/figure/supplement material.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: LC-AMP-F1 increased E. coli membrane permeability and damaged bacterial membrane morphology in vitro.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Directly supports membrane permeabilization/membrane damage under tested E. coli conditions; it does not establish a complete molecular pore model.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: LC-AMP-F1 inhibited formation of E. coli biofilm and showed limited eradication of mature E. coli biofilm; S. aureus 1065 biofilm activity was weaker than melittin in the supplement.
direct_assay_types: crystal violet mature biofilm eradication assay
mechanism_claims.limitations: Biofilm phenotype is not promoted to a direct antibiofilm molecular mechanism.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: LC-AMP-F1 is a 19-residue C-terminally amidated peptide that adopts alpha-helical conformation in 50% TFE but random coil in aqueous environment.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Structure context is supportive and is not itself direct proof of antibacterial mechanism.
